g.text: Initial classification and triage · 3 Portfolio Kanban Boards
Submits demand via Jira request and it auto-redirects to Customer Services or IT Business Applications
Portfolio Kanban Board (Epics) → Squad Kanban Boards (Stories + Tasks).
Replenishment weekly · Daily Flow Review · Service Delivery bi-weekly
Customer Journey Forum monthly (CS) · Iberdrola Sync monthly (Global SAP)
